name: INŻYNIERIA KLIMATU - Klimatyzacja, Rekuperacja, Świadectwa energetyczne

reviews.text: The quote is over 7,500 PLN gross for installing just a humidifier for a heat recovery unit. The same humidifier cost 3,900 PLN gross on Allegro! The person who invoiced it listed it as 3,900 PLN net. During the quote, I asked not to be charged for the humidifier, which I knew well, and I said I could buy it myself, but what wouldn't you do to hide costs? I'm not questioning your knowledge or skills, just the artificial concealment of costs, which I consider unfair.
I highly recommend them. Professional and friendly approach. The work was carried out very professionally.

The air conditioning installation was carried out professionally, thoroughly, and with attention to every detail. The team was punctual, courteous, and well-prepared, and the entire process ran smoothly and without any issues.

Everything was clearly explained, both regarding the operation of the unit and the terms of the contract we signed, with no hidden costs. After the installation, the team left the area perfectly clean, which is rare for this type of service.

We wholeheartedly recommend this company – reliability, professionalism, and top-notch service! If you're looking for a reliable and proven air conditioning installation team, you won't find a better choice. Thank you, and we will definitely recommend them to others!

Honorata & Michał

My wife and I spent a long time searching for a company to handle our home's heat recovery system. Luckily, we finally found Piotr and his team!

I recommend Climate Engineering to people who value:
* professional advice
* friendly customer service
* reliable work
* a clean team that gets the job done without making unnecessary mess, cleaning up after themselves (the installation was carried out in a house already furnished!)
* professionals who meet deadlines and meet all agreements

It's worth noting that the guys didn't finish the job with the installation of the equipment, but they conducted appropriate flow tests (actual performance compared to planned assumptions), completed warranty cards, helped configure the apps, and provided essential knowledge and recommendations.

If you're worried about installing heat recovery systems in your home, I'm confident that everything will go smoothly with the Climate Engineering team!

While searching for an air conditioning company and specifically for heat recovery, I came across Inżynieria Klimatu (Climate Engineering). The contact was immediately positive. I quickly received a quote and allowed them to install the entire heat recovery system in my home, along with two air conditioners. The installers were truly dedicated to their work.
